sharedProjectShellContract.frame: centered modal card max-width 1120px on --bg-base-default with 1px --border-neutral-l1 and --radius-16, body backdrop --bg-base-secondary
sharedProjectShellContract.header: title 使用统计 + 数据更新时间副行; right: currency segmented control (¥ CNY active / $ USD), green-dot badge 6 模型可用, icon-only close button
sharedProjectShellContract.tabBar: 6 tabs 概览/明细/用量/趋势/费率/设置 with data-dom-id tab-overview|tab-providers|tab-tokens|tab-trends|tab-pricing|tab-settings; active tab uses neutral overlay only
sharedProjectShellContract.content: padding var(--spacer-24); section gaps var(--spacer-24); card groups gap var(--spacer-16)
sharedProjectShellContract.footer: thin footer bar: left 每 30s 自动轮询 · 仅统计本机 dsh 会话; right dsh-ui-usage-billing v1.0.0 · MIT, body-xs tertiary
sharedProjectShellContract.typography: body-base 14/20 default; metric display --font-family-metric; token/money figures --code-editor-font-family with tabular-nums
sharedProjectShellContract.colorSystem: single emphasis hue = --status-primary-default blue (product identity); status semantics green/amber/red via --status-success/alert/error; TraeWork purple brand reserved, not used as page accent
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusShadow: cards --radius-12, modal --radius-16, small chips --radius-6/8; no drop shadows on static cards, 1px token borders
sharedProjectShellContract.interactionTone: hover via overlay ladder tokens, transitions 120-200ms opacity/color only

hero number first, KPI grid second, charts/tables third; status color carries meaning
shared modal shell identical across 6 tab pages; surfaces page is a labeled specimen board
hand-drawn clean SVG/CSS charts (no chart library, matching product constraint), tabular-nums everywhere

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Refined-tech billing dashboard redesign per docs/ui-ux-spec.md. Light mode via TraeWork tokens. Emphasis hue is --status-primary-default blue (product identity from spec color semantics); success/alert/error map to 正常/警告/危险 states. Money and token figures use mono tabular-nums; hero metrics use --font-family-metric. Glass treatment (translucent + backdrop blur) reserved for floating layers on the surfaces page only. Charts are hand-drawn clean SVG/CSS matching the product's no-chart-library constraint.
